The high internal self-correlation of these two rigs (pendulum_lab lag-14 autocorrelation 0.857, resonator_obs lag-7 autocorrelation 1.000) is consistent with repeated playback of stable earlier states, not genuine independent measurement variability. The weak cross-correlation of pendulum_lab and resonator_obs with other instruments (best cross-correlations 0.188–0.502, hovering near chance 0.459–0.483) is explained by one corrupted stream unable to co-vary with genuine streams. This hypothesis is mundane (hardware/firmware malfunction is routine), reproducible (loggable via timestamp analysis, buffer inspection, file system metadata), and fully explains the anomaly without invoking exotic physics.
